mentions.name: GroundMe
mentions.description: This is a mental health app designed to tackle dissociation and daydreaming. It uses proven research-based techniques to measure the issues as well as improvements over time.
mentions.problem: Helps people dealing with dissociation and daydreaming, providing measurable tracking of the issues and their improvement.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am about to release a mental health app to tackle dissociation and daydreaming.

Unlike its competitors, it uses proven research and techniques to measure the issues, as well as the improvements.
